scope: Current indexed official Carrefour Pan de Molde category filtered to Carrefour brand. This is a bounded category checkpoint, not a claim that the full Carrefour catalog is inventoried.
notes: Thirteen current Carrefour-brand pan-de-molde identities now have official indexed product-page observations persisted in this batch.
Two gluten-free product pages omit fibre in the visible nutrition table and are therefore persisted as DECLARED_PARTIAL rather than inventing a fibre value.
Current category availability is stored only when explicitly visible (for example temporary out-of-stock); absence of a status is not converted into in-stock.

No external product facts were used. Missing GTINs/images/fields are not inferred. Prices from indexed official Carrefour pages are Carrefour-published evidence with crawl-lag possible, not asserted as live prices.
